source.standard: the house layout built and accepted in this arc
source.machine_form: skills/html-deck/frame.css, the house page markup and the deck page types the builder emits; the measure is standards/checks/measure_fill.py

rules.text: The deck has the pages the request asks for, each in the house page container.
No text is set below 18px and body copy is 22px or more.
One accent colour at most beyond the neutral ground and ink.
Every number printed on the pages appears in the case data.
Every house page carries content across the body: measured on the rendered page, at least 0.12 of the body band covered and at least 0.10 of its lower half.
Every page carries the parts its type calls for.
No content box crosses the footer line and no two content boxes overlap.
